determinism.method: Each criterion was run three times with no change between runs: once at HEAD after the issuer amendment, once as the baseline of its mutant, and once after the mutant was reverted. The head-object read the first criterion makes was repeated by that criterion on each run against the live key, and the served-record reads of the fire (index manifest versions, the refusal record) were taken once and are immutable S3 versions.
determinism.observed: All three criterion runs read PASS for every criterion, six of six, and the live keys read the same ETags each time. The one thing that changed between the first read of these orders and the last was the criteria themselves (amended at a1f10a3824), not the evidence.
